Package com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage

Interface Job

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    JobImpl
    public interface Job
    This represents an instance of a process/flow etc in engine to monitor.

    Thread safety. A Job is the shared unit of concurrency. Multiple threads may concurrently create activities and groups in the same job (e.g. when monitoring parallel branch execution under one job) and record into their own Activity / Group instances. The job-level state that such recording updates as a side effect — status and maximum severity, the instrumentation and trace flags, the estimated message size, attributes, the captured activity error, and the metadata fields — is synchronized internally and safe for concurrent use.

    An individual Activity or Group instance, in contrast, is thread-confined: it is expected to be accessed by a single thread. The SDK does not synchronize mutation of one activity/group instance, because parallel threads are expected to work on separate instances. A caller that genuinely shares a single activity or group instance across threads must synchronize those calls itself. See Activity and Group for details.

    Send cadence is SDK-controlled. nJAMS server, respectively Elasticsearch, is not very good at handling high-frequency updates to the same job (identified by its logId), though it handles high-frequency messages across different jobs without issue. For this reason the SDK — not the caller — decides when a job's log message is actually sent: typically once, at end(boolean), and only more often when the job's accumulated data exceeds the configured flush size or age threshold. There is no supported way to force an additional send from outside the SDK; do not attempt to obtain a sender/transport instance and send messages directly.

    pnientiedt

      • discard

        void discard()
        Discards this job: removes it from the SDK's active-job registry without sending any log message to the nJAMS server.

        Use this to release an abandoned job whose final outcome will never arrive (e.g. a tracking session evicted on an idle timeout), so that the SDK frees the memory it holds for the job instead of keeping it alive for periodic flushing and the final flush on Njams.stop(). Any data recorded so far is dropped and is never reported.

        After discard() the job is treated as finished: isFinished() returns true, and further operations on it behave as they would on an ended job. Discarding a job that has already ended or already been discarded is a no-op. Discarding an unfinished job logs a warning, because data recorded for the job is not reported to the server.

        See Also:
        end(boolean)

      • end

        void end​(boolean normalCompletion)
        Ends processing for this job instance.
        Parameters:
        normalCompletion - Whether the executing engine reported normal completion for this job, or a failure (false).
        This value is used for calculating job status. If the engine reports a fault (false) the job will always gets JobStatus.ERROR. Otherwise the status results from the nJAMS events that have been generated during execution.

      • setStartTime

        void setStartTime​(LocalDateTime jobStart)
        Sets the start timestamp of a job.
        CAUTION:
        This method must not be called after the job has been started. If you need to set the job start explicitly, set it before you call start(). if you don't set the job start explicitly, it is set to the timestamp ob the job creation.
        Parameters:
        jobStart - job start

      • activities

        JobActivities activities()
        Provides access to the runtime activities of this job: the activity registry, lookups, builders, and the start activity.
        Returns:
        the activities facet of this job, never null

      • attributes

        JobAttributes attributes()
        Provides access to the attributes of this job. Attributes are wire data: they are transmitted to the nJAMS server with the next log message.
        Returns:
        the attributes facet of this job, never null

      • metadata

        JobMetadata metadata()
        Provides access to the descriptive metadata of this job: correlation/parent/external log ids and the business fields. The facet's setters are chainable.
        Returns:
        the metadata facet of this job, never null

      • properties

        JobProperties properties()
        Provides access to the internal properties of this job. Properties are client-local only and never transmitted to the nJAMS server.
        Returns:
        the properties facet of this job, never null

      • tracing

        JobTracing tracing()
        Provides access to the tracing flags of this job (deep trace, traces).
        Returns:
        the tracing facet of this job, never null
